subject: general
question: A person borrows a sum of ₹ 50,000 for 3 years at 4% p.a. simple interest. He immediately lends it to another person at 6(1)/(4)\% p.a. simple interest for 3 years. Find his gain in the transaction per year.
solution:
Given: 

Borrowed sum = Lend sum = ₹ 50,000 

Borrows for 3 years at 4% p.a. SI

Lends it for 3 years at 6(1)/(4)\% p.a. SI

Concept used:

SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

Where, P = Principal amount; R = Rate of interest per year;

T = Time (in years)

Calculation:

SI on ₹ 50,000 for 3 years at 4% p.a.

⇒ (50000 × 4 × 3)/100 = ₹ 6000

SI on ₹ 50,000 for 3 years at 6(1)/(4)\% i.e. 6.25% p.a.

⇒ (50000 × 6.25 × 3)/100 = ₹ 9375

Gain per year = (9375 - 6000)/3

⇒ ₹1125

**∴ His gain in the transaction per year is ₹1125.**
